cmd: mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/live-web.service.d && printf '[Service]\nMemoryMax=600M\n' > /etc/systemd/system/live-web.service.d/mem.conf && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl show live-web -p MemoryMax | tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'; P=$(systemctl show live-web -p MainPID --value); for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do echo $(date +%T) $(grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status); sleep 15; done; echo; systemctl is-active live-web
